thread:
hana_sales: NovaCare POC kickoff next week. They want a concrete capacity plan (reserved GPUs vs on-demand), autoscale settings, and short security answers for their vendor form. Can SE/Infra/Sec help draft?

omar_se: Quick workload: baseline 800 RPS, avg 220 tokens, periodic marketing bursts 5k RPS for ~90s. p99 goal <650ms. They also want to test quantized model for cost savings.

leo_infra: Suggest reserved baseline 5 GPUs (A100 equiv), autoscale min=1 max=14, step=2, cooldown=30s. Add burst credits sized for 3x 90s spikes (~120k tokens). Canary route quantized variant for A/B on quality/cost.

hana_sales: Quick price delta to share with buyer? rough percent is fine.

maya_fin: Ballpark: 5-reserved commit ~32% cheaper vs on-demand for sustained hours. Burst credits billed separately; include small POC credit to cover spikes. Will follow up with exact.

sara_sec: Security asks: BYOK KMS, VPC peering, configurable retention, and PHI handling. Also need a one-line attestation about no persistent prompt storage.

leo_infra: One-liners: "KMS: BYOK supported (customer-managed keys)", "VPC peering: supported for Dedicated/Private", "Retention options: 7/30/90/365 days configurable", "PHI: redaction and no-persistent-logs mode available".

omar_se: POC test plan (short):
- Reserve 5 GPUs in customer namespace
- Ramp: 45m to 70% baseline (560 RPS)
- Spike tests: two 90s bursts to 5k RPS separated by 15m
- KV prewarm 25m before spikes
- Monitor: p95/p99, tokens/sec, queue depth, model OOMs

leo_infra: Prewarm command we use:
```
rbw prewarm --namespace novacare --prompts top20.json --duration 1500 --parallel 6
```
Schedule 25-30m prior.

hana_sales: Any blockers before I send to buyer?

sara_sec: Need infra sign-off on PHI attestation language.

leo_infra: Signed: we support no-persistent-logs and can enable PHI redaction; will provide a one-paragraph attestation.

prewarm-bot: Prewarm job queued: prewarm-novacare-2942109876 (status: queued).

hana_sales: Thanks all 44d I'll send the package once Maya posts the POC quote."
